name: UltraFeedback
description: A large-scale preference dataset of prompts and model responses annotated with instruction-following, truthfulness, honesty, and helpfulness feedback, including pairwise preference data used for training and evaluating language models.
citation: Cui, G., Yuan, L., Ding, N., Yao, G., Zhu, W., Ni, Y., Xie, G., Liu, Z., & Sun, M. (2023). ULTRAFEEDBACK: Boosting Language Models with High-quality Feedback. arXiv:2310.01377. https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.01377

license.notes: The upstream repository does not specify a standard SPDX license for the dataset; this descriptive identifier is not an SPDX identifier. Review upstream terms and the rights and terms applicable to source prompts and generated responses before use or redistribution.
